title_ar: الشيخ الددو: يجب على الأمة جميعا أن تبادر لنصرة الشعب السوري
title_en: Sheikh al-Dedew: It Is Obligatory for the Whole Community to Move to Support the Syrian People
body_ar:
قال فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن ولد الددو رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء، وعضو الاتحاد العالمي لعلماء المسلمين إنه يجب على الأمة الإسلامية أن تبادر لنصرة الشعب السوري المظلوم.

وقال الشيخ - خلال حلقة من برنامج الشريعة والحياة الذي تبثه قناة الجزيرة- وبمشاركة رئيس رابطة علماء الشام إن على الأمة الإسلامية أن تقوم بما أمرها الله به من نصرة هؤلاء المظلومين والتعاون معهم على تجاوز ما هم فيه؛ ويشمل ذلك دعمهم بالمال والعتاد، مؤكدا أن من واجب كل شخص أن يتقاسم مع إخوانه السوريين معاشه ومافيه إنقاذ وإغاثة للمستضعفين.

وأضاف الشيخ أن ما يجري في سوريا جهاد لا مرية فيه وتنطبق عليه أحكام الجهاد، فالذين يجاهدون في سوريا الآن حاملهم الأول على الجهاد هو الدفاع عن النفس والعرض و الدين، والنبي صلى الله عليه وسلم يقول: "من قتل دون دينه فهو شهيد".

وقد شارك فضيلة الشيخ محمد الحسن في مؤتمرعلماء الأمة الداعي لنصرة الشعب السوري المقام في القاهرة يوم 13/06/2013.
body_en:
His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan Ould al-Dedew, president of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars and member of the International Union of Muslim Scholars, said that it is obligatory (wājib) upon the Muslim community to move to support the wronged Syrian people.

The Sheikh said — during an episode of the programme 'Sharia and Life' broadcast by the al-Jazeera channel, in which the president of the Association of the Scholars of Sham also took part — that the Muslim community must carry out what God has commanded it in supporting these wronged people and cooperating with them in overcoming what they are in; and that this includes supporting them with money and materiel — affirming that it is the duty of every person to share with his Syrian brothers his own livelihood, and whatever brings rescue and relief to the oppressed.

The Sheikh added that what is taking place in Syria is jihad in which there is no doubt, and that the rulings of jihad apply to it; for those who are fighting (yujāhidūn) in Syria now, the first thing impelling them to jihad is the defence of life, of honour and of religion — and the Prophet (peace and blessings be upon him) says: 'Whoever is killed defending his religion is a martyr.'

His Eminence Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan took part in the conference of the community's scholars calling for support of the Syrian people, held in Cairo on 13/06/2013.

flags.arabic: ما يجري في سوريا جهاد لا مرية فيه وتنطبق عليه أحكام الجهاد … ويشمل ذلك دعمهم بالمال والعتاد
flags.context: the Sheikh's own position, as reported from a television programme
options: jihad in which there is no doubt, and the rulings of jihad apply to it … supporting them with money and materiel
an unquestionable struggle to which the rules of jihad apply … supporting them with funds and equipment
flags.note: EDITORIAL REVIEW — the most exposed ruling in this slice. The Sheikh is reported as classifying an ongoing armed conflict as jihad, holding the legal rulings of jihad to apply to it, and stating that the community's obligation to support includes 'المال والعتاد'. 'العتاد' is materiel, i.e. arms and equipment, and cannot be rendered as 'supplies' without changing the ruling. 'واجب' and 'يجب' are rendered on the fixed mapping as obligatory (wājib). Nothing has been softened. In English this reads as a scholar obliging an audience to fund and equip an armed party to a foreign conflict, which carries serious legal exposure in several jurisdictions; publication is a decision for Ummah Collective and the Sheikh's office, never a default.

flags.context: the prophetic report cited in support
options: Whoever is killed defending his religion is a martyr
Whoever is slain in defence of his religion is a martyr
flags.note: The report is known in the collections with 'دون ماله', 'دون دمه', 'دون أهله' and 'دون دينه' in various wordings. The reporter gives no collection and no grading, and per style guide §4 none has been added. The wording is translated exactly as printed.

flags.context: the Sheikh's fellow guest on the programme
options: the president of the Association of the Scholars of Sham
the president of the League of Levantine Scholars
flags.note: The second speaker is unnamed in the source, and part of what the paragraph reports may be his and not the Sheikh's — the sentence structure does not make clear where one voice ends. Flagged so that a reviewer checks the episode before any of the third paragraph is attributed to the Sheikh.

translator_notes: A news summary of a television appearance, not a written fatwā and not a transcript. Marked critical_for_display because a serious ruling on an armed conflict is presented in a reporter's compressed paraphrase, without the conditions, qualifications or distinctions the Sheikh would have given at length on air; the recording, not this page, is the authority. 'جهاد' is left as jihad with the Arabic visible rather than rendered by any English abstraction. Source spacing errors 'ومافيه' and 'مؤتمرعلماء' preserved in body_ar. CMS date is a bulk-upload timestamp, not a composition date.
